title: Edexcel GCSE Chemistry
description:
Complete Edexcel GCSE Chemistry course covering the 1CH0 specification.

Topics include:
• Key concepts in chemistry
• States of matter and mixtures
• Chemical changes
• Extracting metals and equilibria
• Groups in the periodic table
• Rates of reaction and energy changes
• Fuels and Earth science
• Earth and atmospheric science
• Organic chemistry

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and exam-style questions.
subject: chemistry
